fato_historico: 2025: Six people are killed when Israel carries out an airstrike on Doha in a failed attempt to decapitate the Hamas leadership.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find harmony amidst the turbulence of the world. While news of conflict and loss may weigh heavy on your heart, remember that even in shadowed times, your light serves as a beacon. Focus on connection and gentle communication, as these small acts act as a clover leaf of hope in an unpredictable universe.
frase_do_dia: Even the smallest spark of kindness can illuminate the darkest path forward today.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual awareness and inner peace through change.
conselho: Consider reaching out to a dear friend to share a moment of sincere comfort.
